entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys know what a trick shot is?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I recently saw it on TV. It was really cool!
entries.uk: Нещодавно бачив по телевізору.[n]Було дуже круто!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think it was called the...[clr 1]jump shot[clr 27]![n]Let's give it a go!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! That sounds like fun!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, you wanna try a trick shot?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think it was called the [clr 1]back hand[clr 27].[n]You think we can do it?
entries.uk: Здається, він називався [clr 1]удар з-за спини[clr 27].[n]Думаєш, у нас вийде?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You can't even hold a cue stick.
entries.uk: Ти ж навіть кия втримати не можеш.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys, let's try a trick shot!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's try the one called [clr 1]massé[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If only I was two legged...[n]Fine, I'll let you take the spotlight,[n][fName]!
entries.uk: От якби я був двоногим...[n]Гаразд, віддаю тобі всю славу,[n][fName]!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's try a trick shot!
You're really good! You're probably[n]the next coolest guy—after me of course!
entries.uk: А ти вправний! Мабуть, ти другий[n]найкрутіший хлопець — після мене, звісно!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Progression is power. You looked real[n]good when you were giving it your best.
entries.uk: Прогрес — це сила. Ти мав дуже[n]класний вигляд, коли викладався на повну.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All set!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's ready!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're ready to go!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Set up complete.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You should be good to go.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's all set up for you!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Set up mission, complete!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're good to go.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: The stage is yours.
